description: This file declares the WmediumdServer class, which is part of the cuttlefish namespace. The class manages a server component related to wireless medium simulation, inheriting from vm_manager::VmmDependencyCommand. It includes methods for command retrieval, enabling status, waiting for availability, and dependency management, and holds references to configuration and utility classes.

classes.name: WmediumdServer
classes.description: A class representing a server component for wireless medium management within the cuttlefish virtualization environment, providing command execution, status, and dependency management functionalities.
